title: W0 Receiver Handoff Package
description: Snapshot-only lifecycle v1 handoff. The package itself is not a validator-runtime trust root. Receiver acceptance uses the operator-pinned PREPARE→VALIDATE→ADMIT bootstrap with signed PREPARE/prelaunch/postexecution records, continuous project/source/temp lock, an operator-external human run-authorization chain, an expected-only signed run admission, and a separately signed post-semantic ADMIT execution/worker-ready receipt before bootstrap PASS or the first effect. Any project-local run-auth evidence, commit baseline, missing full snapshot-copy proof, lock gap, runtime swap/add, early worker launch, stale/replayed capability, or unverified loaded closure is STOP/HUMAN.

acceptanceProvenanceMode.description: Every approval, D1.5, D4 capsule/lane, and lifecycle provenance_verification reachable from this package must have verificationMode pinned-signature and rehashable signed evidence. Each signed final PV must exist before the first immutable candidate/baseline/audit record binds its hash. trusted-runtime-query is never executed by the W0 receiver and cannot be converted or replaced at packaging time; a bound query-mode PV requires rebuilding from its owning stage/new candidate.

allOf.description: The original gdd-gate1 machine record; targetArtifact fixes the exact Draft GDD revision/bytes through B1 and its closed scope fixes approvedIntake and requiredSpecs path/hash bindings. The record remains unchanged. B1→B2 may alter only the separately verified fixed D5 formal metadata; receiver normalizes that metadata and requires identical GDD body digest.

gddD5Transformation.description: Receiver requires gate1DraftSha256 == b1Sha256 at the Gate1 target path. The exact forward transform changes the unique '| Status | Draft |' row to Approved, changes the unique '| Last approved | — |' row to d5ApprovedAt, and appends exactly one change-history row '| {unchanged B1 Version} | {d5ApprovedAt} | D5 metadata promotion {d5ApprovalId} | {d5Approval.approver} |'; every other UTF-8 byte is unchanged. Inverse-transforming B2 must reproduce raw B1 bytes exactly. normalizedBodySha256 is SHA-256 of those inverse-transformed raw bytes and therefore equals b1Sha256; it is not a placeholder-normalized serialization. d5ApprovalId/time/approver exact-match the D5 gate and fixed transition event.

d15Measurements.description: Exactly zero or one schema-valid combined-suite D1.5 pass record with external provenance. required_specs without feasibility_report requires zero; feasibility_report requires one feasibility_report-combined-v1 record. E0 is never evidence.

approvalCaptures.description: Four distinct, non-reusable human approval captures. Receiver traverses each challengeArtifact to one presentationArtifact and revalidates distinct presentation/challenge/capture IDs/paths/hashes, presentation and human message IDs, statement artifacts, chronology, typed target/scope, and gate-record sourceEvidence. Gate 1 scope includes immutable approvedIntake and requiredSpecs refs.

approvalVerifications.description: Outer provenance_verification records for the four captures. Under operator-external pinned config, receiver offline-verifies provider signatures over presentation and human response roles/times/content plus actor/channel/target and issued <= presentation < response <= capture <= verification. Runtime query, network send, local transcript/hash alone, or an unsigned creation-time query result is invalid at W0.

lifecycleTransitions.description: Distinct cycle-free P0 and D5 transition attestation/provenance/write-log chains. Receiver parses both closed logs, exact-covers every source→snapshot file copy and source→canonical publication event, recomputes count/set/sequence/copy-map hashes, exact-compares attestation and outer claims, and offline-verifies pinned signatures from the actual-operation authority. P0 proof is created after snapshot freeze/apply/seal and gates post-P0 D4/B1; D5 proof is created after complete B2 snapshot/seal and is carried only outside B2 here. Runtime query, hidden VCS writes, commit revisions, local logs, or self-attestation alone are invalid.

baselines.description: All three referenced manifests must be schema-valid snapshot revisions with immutable snapshotRoot bytes. B0/B1 retain the exact Gate1-approved Draft GDD; B2 may differ only by the fixed D5 formal metadata transform and must preserve the normalized body digest.

allOf.description: Independent post-sync manifest containing path, bytes, and SHA-256 for every synchronized artifact.

firstAuthorizedWp.description: Historical field name: selects the first W0 handoff-target WP only. sha256 is current post-sync WP bytes covered by B2, never the B1 transaction input. After VALIDATE signed PASS, while the same project/source/temp lock remains active, receiver obtains the standard pre-response human chain and offline-signed w0-run-authorization-v1 entirely at operator-external paths. ADMIT verifies that chain plus expected-only signed w0-run-admission-v1, re-observes this WP/B2/package, and runs semantic validation without launching the worker. Only after semantic PASS may authority atomically consume the unexpired admission token, launch the assigned worker suspended/pre-entry, compare its actual Skill tree/process closure with the approved expected digests, and sign the ADMIT execution/worker-ready receipt. Bootstrap verifies that receipt before PASS; authority consumes the fresh global-nonreuse worker-ready capability immediately before the one scoped first effect. No assigned-worker launch or project/Studio/network implementation side effect may precede semantic PASS, and no product effect may precede receipt verification and capability consumption; exact authority-monitored bootstrap temp/challenge/proof operations are separate and grant no product authority.

allOf.description: Shared capsule contains assemblyAttestation and capsuleAssemblyProvenance refs. Receiver revalidates installed fixed preflight policy, complete target-revision tree, actual argv/exits/raw outputs, and commit/snapshot source rules.
